summary: Full backend + frontend test of new admin panel /donascimentopainel. 12/12 pytest tests pass. All UI flows verified: login (bad/good creds), dashboard cards + charts + presence + online sessions, sidebar nav (dashboard/atividade/leads/config), logout, protected routes, orcamento form -> POST /api/leads -> lead visible in admin panel, config save reflects in /api/config/public. Public tracking events populate presence/stats correctly.

issues: Recharts logs width/height(-1) warnings on initial render — cosmetic only; charts render correctly after layout settles

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — will be removed in future FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handler.
PATCH /api/admin/leads/{id} accepts arbitrary Dict[str, Any]; Pydantic model would be safer.
Presence uses $last inside $group without $sort within group scope — order of last_page/ip/user_agent may be non-deterministic; consider $sort before $group by created_at then use $first.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed leads and pageview events during testing; TEST_UI_* lead persisted in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel fully working. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_api.py cover auth, tracking, leads, stats, activity, presence, config CRUD (12 tests). Frontend uses data-testid extensively (admin-login-page, admin-login-email/password/submit/error, admin-dashboard, card-*, presence-badge, chart-24h, chart-top-pages, online-sessions, nav-*, btn-logout, admin-activity, btn-toggle-live, admin-leads, admin-settings, cfg-wa-number/message/save, orc-form/nome/telefone/submit).
